about: Mont-Tremblant is a city in the Laurentians, Quebec, encompassing the resort village, the mountain, and surrounding lake country northwest of Montréal—not only the ski resort. Lac Tremblant, pedestrian tourist village, and vast park approaches define one of Quebec’s premier four-season destinations. About 10,000 people live in Mont-Tremblant.
seoSummary: Laurentian resort city northwest of Montréal—ski mountain, pedestrian village, and Lac Tremblant lake country.
